summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing open-market treasury share repurchases under a buyback program approved on 6 May 2026. During 17–21 August 2026, it acquired 3,108,616 shares (0.10% of capital) at a weighted average price of €24.1265, total consideration €74,999,932. Cumulative program purchases since 8 May total 59,789,927 shares (1.97%) for €1,339,916,017.69. The program funds additional shareholder remuneration alongside dividends. Eni now holds 4.84% of share capital. No premium, tender structure, or advisor is involved; this is routine issuer buyback activity. Watch for continued daily purchase cadence and completion of the authorized tranche.
